labels.ac: Geocoder API timeout enqueues record into geocode_retry_jobs and returns 200 OK fallback.
labels.desc: The fetch POST to geocode_retry_jobs never checked response.ok, so a rejected insert (HTTP 4xx/5xx) was silently treated as enqueued and the retry job was lost without any signal.
